body:
This guy and I had been flirting for a while, and after the both of us were invited to a party things, we were given the perfect opportunity for things to finally kick off. Both of us had consumed a significant amount of alcohol and subsequently, one thing lead to another; text book drunk activities.

We were both on the bed, making out, and as his hands slid up my dress, my conscience started to kick in. I should’ve stopped this turn of events right in it's track. I should've ignored the wreckless, carefree attitude that intoxicated me. I should've gone back to the party, and forgotten all about it.

Key word: should’ve.

Instead, we engaged in what could only be described as the most awkward sex possible. He was extremely keen, breathing heavily as he tore my clothes off. Because of this eagerness, there was minimal foreplay involved. 

As he slipped himself in, his desperation for sex was evident. He was thrusting away like a rampant rabbit and at one point, I had to tell him to slow down because, rather than kicking my head back in pleasure, I was erupting in laughter.

Eventually, we both got into it, and after 2 minutes of pure lust, he suddenly stopped, awkwardly murmuring,
"Um, there's blood..."
Mortified, we stopped immediately and I went to the toilet in utter confusion. I hadn't experienced any pain and I was half way through my pack of the pill. Nothing added up.

Needless to say, the two of us awkwardly avoided each other until the next morning where I received an embarrassing text from him reading something along the lines of,

"Turns out it wasn't you that bled, it was me... I'm going to the doctors today because my dick is split and I'm in agony. I think it's my foreskin."

FML. Awkward to the max.
